# Flock

> Flock is an open-source AI agent plugin workflow for source-grounded knowledge graphs, evidence audits, synthetic social simulations, and scenario comparison.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://flock.daalgp.com/): Product overview, supported hosts, and workflow.
- [Documentation](https://flock.daalgp.com/docs.html): Installation, first project, Evidence Audit, Scenario Lab, privacy, and license.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/plilian/flock): Source code and release details.

## Product facts

- Installable packages are available for Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Qwen Code. DeepSeek Harness support is a developer preview, not an integration for the DeepSeek chat website or API.
- Flock has no separate model API key, hosted model, Zep dependency, or Flock account. The selected AI host's sign-in, provider configuration, plan, and usage limits apply.
- Flock stores graph and simulation data in a workspace-local SQLite database under `.flock/`. The helper makes no model or network calls.
- Evidence Audit checks citation structure and supports a host-model review of source meaning; citations do not prove a claim is true.
- Scenario Lab compares controlled variants and replicate runs using synthetic agents. Results are thought experiments, not polls, observations, or forecasts about real people.
- Flock is licensed under AGPL-3.0 and is an independent, substantially modified derivative of MiroFish. See the documentation and repository attribution notice.
